name: Redmine relay
description: Lets the redmine_mattermost Redmine plugin post notifications as the Mattermost user who acted in Redmine.

settings_schema.header: Redmine posts through this plugin with the access token of its bot account. A post is published as the user who acted in Redmine when that user exists in Mattermost and can post in the channel, otherwise as the bot.

settings.help_text: Username of the account whose access token Redmine uses (several names can be separated by commas). Requests from any other account are refused.
When no Mattermost user has the Redmine login as username, look the user up by email address.
